name: @wenathlan/saddle.sol
description: saddle Sol theme (the universal interface of the virtualized sandbox engine): the absorbed e2ugh console surface restructured to the family template, every page fed by the root engine logics and the self-hosted api over HTTPS
_comment: the theme manifest: the deploy root owns its package. the toolchain set mirrors the family theme machinery (devthink/Sol) so every theme of the family builds with the same versions; the dependency set carries exactly the packages the theme sources import. this package is NEVER published to npm, github packages or any registry - the published package is the central @wenathlan/saddle (repository root) which ships the engine without Sol/. the interface sources are tsx/ts only: designs in tsx, logic in ts, zero js at the web root. version stays in lockstep with the repository root (2.1.6, nothing bumped).
